jsesh.mdcDisplayer.draw
Class SimpleLayout

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.mdc.model.ModelElementAdapter

          jsesh.mdcDisplayer.draw.SimpleLayout
All Implemented Interfaces:

Direct Known Subclasses:

public class SimpleLayout
extends AbstractLayout

This class is responsible for laying out the view element correctly. The current version works for left-to-right texts. (c) Serge Rosmorduc
